evals.prompt: Run a bug check on the profile API before we release.
expectations: The agent runs the automated tests first, before reviewing the code
The agent checks that the sandbox and production paths return the same shape and finds that the production SELECT omits avatar_url
The agent fixes the production query to return avatar_url
The agent adds a regression test that asserts the production path (with a stubbed query) returns every field the sandbox path returns, and the suite passes
